visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a long-sleeved grey dress and black over-the-knee boots, stands in a modern indoor atrium. She is holding a silver transverse flute to her mouth, her fingers actively pressing the keys. The setting features concrete walls, wooden stairs with black metal railings, and lush green plants trailing from the railings. (2) The scene cuts to a scenic wide shot of Sun Moon Lake. The calm blue-green water is surrounded by rolling green mountains under a bright, slightly cloudy sky. (3) The woman is now on an outdoor balcony with a black railing, continuing to play her flute. The background is filled with dense green trees and foliage, with natural daylight illuminating her face and the silver instrument. (4) The camera pans through a minimalist hotel room. It shows a wooden console with a television, a remote control, and a humidifier. The walls are finished in a light grey concrete texture, and the furniture is primarily light-toned wood. (5) A wider shot of the hotel room reveals a large double bed with white linens, a small seating area with a grey sofa, and a large window with white sheer curtains. (6) The camera moves into the bathroom area, showing a modern white toilet, a glass-enclosed shower/tub area, and clean white towels. (7) Back to the atrium, the camera looks upward through the multi-story open space, highlighting the architectural layers, wooden stairs, and hanging green plants under a skylight. (8) Final shot of the woman playing the flute on the balcony, her eyes focused as she performs, surrounded by the natural greenery of the outdoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 日月潭山慕藝旅 Sun Moon Inn. [Variety]: 長笛姐姐沈浸式開箱. (2) [Slogan]: 《山慕藝旅》知名日月潭民宿. [Slogan]: Google 評論 4.9 顆星. [Slogan]: 南投縣魚池鄉中山路 216 號. (3) [Subtitle]: 側靠在日月潭水社碼頭旁. [Subtitle]: 步行幾步就能擁抱萬心橫渡煙嵐. [Subtitle]: 登高遠眺日月潭水畫廊風景統統收眼底. (4) [Subtitle]: 非常喜歡文青極簡風風格. [Subtitle]: 入住當天由細心的小管家協助 check in. [Subtitle]: 整個空間帶有草本植物的淡雅清香. [Subtitle]: 療癒的旋律讓心情慢慢放鬆了下來. (5) [Slogan]: 演奏這首曲目 龍貓《風的通道》. [Slogan]: 好像置身宮崎駿般動畫 深山裡的祕密仙境. (6) [Subtitle]: 綠色植物點綴著整棟建築. [Subtitle]: 低調清水模的日式風格. [Subtitle]: 彷彿回到了最舒適又熟悉的空間. [Subtitle]: 享受著旅途中最親切如回家一般的懷抱. (7) [Subtitle]: 屬於南投人心目中印象深刻的日月潭民宿. [Subtitle]: 推薦給那個尋找平靜療癒基地的你.

The tempo is a steady, contemplative 72 BPM. (3) The musical phrases flow into a second section where the flute performs higher-register notes with expressive vibrato. The piano chords become slightly more resonant, providing a warm, supportive bed for the woodwind lead. (4) The track maintains its serene and cinematic quality until the end, concluding with a gentle fade-out of the final flute note and sustaining piano resonance, creating a sense of peace and closure.
